column_description: TEXT. Associated data-flow identifier for this profile. FK to DataFlow.
BIGINT. Linked risk-management identifier. FK to RiskManagement.
TEXT. Primary data-type description. Possible values: Commercial, Financial, Industrial, Medical, Personal.
TEXT. Data-sensitivity description. Possible values: Critical, High, Low, Medium.
REAL. Volume of data in gigabytes. Example: 1093.6. Example: 1093.6.
BIGINT. Total number of data records. Example: 2629296. Example: 2629296.
BIGINT. Count of data subjects represented. Example: 754585. Example: 754585.
BIGINT. Data-retention period in days. Example: 2208. Example: 2208.
TEXT. Data-format type (e.g., CSV, Parquet). Possible values: Mixed, Structured, Unstructured. Possible values: Mixed, Structured, Unstructured.
REAL. Data quality score. Example: 52.45. Example: 52.45.
TEXT. Data-integrity check result. **NULL means integrity check not performed.**. Possible values: Failed, Partial, Passed. Possible values: Failed, Partial, Passed.
TEXT. Checksum-verification status. Possible values: Failed, Pending, Success. Possible values: Failed, Pending, Success.
TEXT. Source-validation state. **NULL means source validation not performed.**. Possible values: Failed, Pending, Verified. Possible values: Failed, Pending, Verified.
TEXT. Destination-validation state. Possible values: Failed, Pending, Verified. Possible values: Failed, Pending, Verified.
